summary: Ikariam entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Ikariam

primary.why: Ikariam is an official Gameforge browser strategy game, so preservation depends on the current live server/client state rather than a static boxed version. Server, world, account age, and premium/account state define the archive context.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official browser version through Gameforge. Record server/world, account, alliance state, premium features used, browser, version/date, and whether mobile/app access was used.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official main route for the live game.
skip: useful access path, but the browser account/server state is the main archive object.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The game is a live browser service, so completeness is defined by account/server progress and current version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service state can change; archive by date, server, and account state.
